# A place for everything you discover.

Welcome to your codex. A collection of ideas, places and connections, kept in plain Markdown and built one page at a time.

## Start exploring

The navigation follows your folders. Begin with [a guide to the codex](guides/getting-started.md), or step into the [example world](atlas/the-quiet-coast.md).

There is no menu to maintain. A new page finds its place as soon as you publish it.

## Make connections

Knowledge becomes more useful when it connects. Link one page to another using ordinary Markdown:

```markdown
[The quiet coast](atlas/the-quiet-coast.md)
```

You can also link directly to a section, such as [the coastal settlements](atlas/the-quiet-coast.md#settlements).

## Keep the story of your work

Every saved change has a history. The local workspace lets you revisit earlier versions and see exactly what changed, while readers always see the latest published edition.

> A useful archive is never finished. It simply becomes easier to find your way through.
